f3_program: collection("gecko.three_day_crickets", "cricket", "three_day_period", source("70 crickets every three days"))
observe(at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "initial"), 70, "count", source("70 crickets every three days"))
observe(at("gecko.three_day_period.duration", "current"), 3, "day", source("every three days"))

consume("first_day_consumption", "gecko", at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "current"), fraction(at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "initial"), 30, 100), source("The first day she eats 30% of the crickets"))
offset(at("gecko.crickets_eaten.second_day.count", "day_2"), event_field("first_day_consumption", "quantity"), -6, "count", source("The second day she eats 6 less than the first"))

consume("second_day_consumption", "gecko", at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "current"), at("gecko.crickets_eaten.second_day.count", "day_2"), source("The second day she eats 6 less than the first"))

sum_relation(at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "initial"), event_field("first_day_consumption", "quantity"), event_field("second_day_consumption", "quantity"), at("gecko.crickets_eaten.third_day.count", "day_3"), source("the third day she finishes up the remaining crickets"))

consume("third_day_consumption", "gecko", at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "current"), at("gecko.crickets_eaten.third_day.count", "day_3"), source("the third day she finishes up the remaining crickets"))
query("value", event_field("third_day_consumption", "quantity"))

collection("uf.previous_games", "game", "previous_24_games", source("their previous 24 games"))
observe(at("uf.points.total", "previous_24_games"), 720, "point", source("a total of 720 points during their previous 24 games"))
observe(at("uf.previous_games.count", "previous_24_games"), 24, "count", source("their previous 24 games"))

rate_relation(at("uf.points.total", "previous_24_games"), at("uf.points.per_game", "previous_24_games"), at("uf.previous_games.count", "previous_24_games"), source("a total of 720 points during their previous 24 games"))

fraction_of(at("uf.points.half_previous_per_game", "championship_game"), at("uf.points.per_game", "previous_24_games"), 1, 2, source("half as much as they had previously scored in each of the 24 games"))

offset(at("uf.points", "championship_game"), at("uf.points.half_previous_per_game", "championship_game"), -2, "point", source("they scored 2 points less than half as much as they had previously scored in each of the 24 games"))
offset(at("uf.opponent.points", "championship_game"), at("uf.points", "championship_game"), -2, "point", source("Their opponent only lost by 2 points"))
query("value", at("uf.opponent.points", "championship_game"))
collection("bucket.sourball_candies", "candy", "bucket", source("a bucket of 30 candies"))
collection("candy_eaters", "person", "group", source("all of them ate until they cried"))
member("candy_eaters", "nellie", source("Nellie can eat 12 sourball candies before crying"))
member("candy_eaters", "jacob", source("Jacob can only manage half of that number of candies"))
member("candy_eaters", "lana", source("Lana can only do three fewer than Jacob"))
observe(at("nellie.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("Nellie can eat 12 sourball candies before crying"))

fraction_of(at("jacob.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), at("nellie.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("Jacob can only manage half of that number of candies"))
offset(at("lana.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), at("jacob.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), -3, "count", source("Lana can only do three fewer than Jacob"))
observe(at("bucket.sourball_candies.count", "initial"), 30, "count", source("a bucket of 30 candies"))

consume("nellie_eats_until_crying", "nellie", at("bucket.sourball_candies.count", "current"), at("nellie.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), source("all of them ate until they cried"))
consume("jacob_eats_until_crying", "jacob", at("bucket.sourball_candies.count", "current"), at("jacob.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), source("all of them ate until they cried"))
consume("lana_eats_until_crying", "lana", at("bucket.sourball_candies.count", "current"), at("lana.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), source("all of them ate until they cried"))
collection("candy_eaters.remaining_candy_shares", "candy_share", "candy_eaters", source("divide the remaining candies in the bucket equally"))
member("candy_eaters.remaining_candy_shares", "nellie.remaining_sourball_candy_share.count", source("they divide the remaining candies in the bucket equally"))
member("candy_eaters.remaining_candy_shares", "jacob.remaining_sourball_candy_share.count", source("they divide the remaining candies in the bucket equally"))
member("candy_eaters.remaining_candy_shares", "lana.remaining_sourball_candy_share.count", source("they divide the remaining candies in the bucket equally"))
partition("candy_eaters.remaining_candy_shares", at("bucket.sourball_candies.count", "current"), source("divide the remaining candies in the bucket equally"))
same(at("nellie.remaining_sourball_candy_share.count", "current"), at("jacob.remaining_sourball_candy_share.count", "current"), source("divide the remaining candies in the bucket equally"))
same(at("nellie.remaining_sourball_candy_share.count", "current"), at("lana.remaining_sourball_candy_share.count", "current"), source("divide the remaining candies in the bucket equally"))
query("value", at("nellie.remaining_sourball_candy_share.count", "current"))
